title: Rule Schema
description: Constraint / rule definitions: constraint types, applicability conditions, severity levels. Rules are validated against measurement and fixture placement data.

ruleId.description: Stable UUID for this rule. Used for traceability in violation reports.

type.description: Category of constraint this rule enforces.

severity.description: Severity level. 'error' = hard block, must be resolved. 'warning' = should be reviewed. 'info' = advisory.

applicability.description: Conditions under which this rule applies. If absent, the rule applies unconditionally.

parameters.description: Rule-specific parameters. Key-value pairs that configure the rule's behavior.

Applicability.description: Conditions that determine when this rule should be evaluated.

requiredFixtures.description: Rule only applies when all listed fixture types are present.

minRoomArea.description: Rule only applies when room floor area >= this value (in mm²).

hasWindow.description: Rule only applies when room has (or lacks) a window.

hasDrain.description: Rule only applies when room has (or lacks) a floor drain.
